rows.descriptionText: Visiting heroes may sacrifice creatures in exchange for experience.
rows.notes: building pass 2026-11-22: cove.grotto (owner decision 2: build the window now). Plugin-only banks carrier, no native bonus. Homm3CoveGrottoRuntime/Window open an exchange window from a town-screen 'Grotto' button: each creature gives floor(squadValue / 40) x 5 experience (HoMM3 Altar of Sacrifice formula on OE squadValue); the hero keeps at least one creature. Artifact sacrifice is not offered (no save-safe native artifact removal), so the text says creatures only. HotA cost 7500 Gold, 15 Wood, 15 Ore. Tree: Market (tree agent).

rows.descriptionText: The owner's cities produce 1000 Gold and 1 of each other resource daily. All terrain counts as native terrain for your armies. This city's dwellings produce +100% units.
rows.notes: building pass 2026-11-22: cove.lodestar. Keeps the HumanGraal economy (answer 3) and adds the HotA terrain clause as the native anyLandEqualNativeLandBonus (Unfrozen law 34's bonus, no parameters). Static evidence (26615913): graal side bonuses share the law bonus path, and the bonus reaches the creature native check but not the battle side's own native flag, so Homm3CoveLodestarRuntime forces the side and stack native flags at BattleLogic.Init for a side owning a Lodestar (one switch, FallbackEnabled, logged per side). Covers every unit of the army: OE has no per-faction native qualifier.

descriptionTextLocales.japanese: 所有者の都市は毎日1000ゴールドと、他の各資源を1ずつ生産する。すべての地形が自軍にとっての本拠地地形として扱われる。この都市の居住施設は+100%のユニットを生産する。

descriptionTextLocales.spanish: Las ciudades del propietario producen cada día 1000 de oro y 1 de cada uno de los demás recursos. Todo el terreno cuenta como terreno nativo para tus ejércitos. Las viviendas de esta ciudad producen +100 % de unidades.
